description: Where the user's generations are: pass the jobIds from generate_music/derive_music with wait=false (or omit job_ids to list every unfinished one of the account). Each job is waiting (its turn in the account's queue: the account generates one track at a time and the rest follow on their own), queued (with the engine), running, done (with the new versions; if the event had no chosen version, the new one was chosen when it finished, like wait=true) or failed (the reason; nothing is charged for a failure). A track takes minutes: check every few minutes, not in a loop, and tell the user the music pages meanwhile.

job_ids.description: The jobIds to check (up to 50). Omitted: every unfinished generation of the account.

name: job_status
title: Generation status
